items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: And Walter Scott and I ------- pretty much.

ctx.x: But I would have preferred to have had piano. I would have liked it better with a piano. We just had a bass and drums and -- what did we have? Just bass and drums, that's all. And Walter Scott and I ------- pretty much. Let me see now, if I had a choice, "Texas Twister." There's my choice.
